name: com.kanaworks.sakuga-vfx
description: Plays the KanaWorks SAKUGA VFX anime-style flipbooks (hand-drawn look) in URP: an unlit flipbook shader (alpha blend or additive, camera or upright billboard, Particle System texture-sheet compatible), a small play-once / loop component, an importer that builds a material and a prefab from each .flipbook.json sidecar, and a demo scene builder. Code is MIT; the flipbook images are under the KanaWorks_AI VFX Asset License.
